The beauty of statistics is that there is always more to learn, it’s just a matter of identifying the missing pieces to build a solid foundation. As a PhD student, I’ve worked with hundreds of students and understand that everyone has a different starting point. 

Whether you are struggling with core concepts or excelling and want to go beyond the syllabus, my goal is to meet you where you are. I create custom supplementary materials tailored to your specific needs so we can bridge those gaps together. Fill out the quick form below, and let's get you on track!!
